item.title: MacVoices #26282: Live! - After Dark HomeView and Apple TV Analysis
item.description: In a MacVoices After Dark supplemental, members of the panel continue their discussion of Apple's HomeView and Apple TV announcements. Pricing, functionality, and real-world value are debated as they examine HomeView's potential as a smart home controller, its limitations compared to an iPad, and possible future capabilities...
